import sys, tarfile, zipfile, io, os
def rep(items, n):
    items.sort(reverse=True)
    tot=sum(s for s,_ in items)
    print(f"FILE {os.path.basename(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv)>1 else '')}")

if sys.argv[1].endswith('.zip'):
    z=zipfile.ZipFile(sys.argv[1]); rep([(i.file_size,i.filename) for i in z.infolist() if not i.is_dir()], len(z.infolist()))
else:
    t=tarfile.open(sys.argv[1]); rep([(m.size,m.name) for m in t if m.isfile()], len(t.getmembers()))
EOF
